accepted_title: 5100026: credited alternative reproof of the qualified k407 theorem
accepted_body:
Research classification: **already_solved**; this is a credited existing-result alternative reproof. Accepted mathematical and priority evidence identifies [Alper Ferudun's complete matching proof](https://eulersolve.org/papers/amr-050-0026/), [DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23071366](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23071366), associated with the current exact archive attachments. Recorded deposit/DOI clocks precede PR creation; the PDF/TeX date discrepancy is preserved. No first-visibility, worldwide-priority or causal assertion follows.

The scoped theorem assumes **even least period N≥4**, strict nondegenerate confocal elliptical caustic, every phase and coprime star, original tangent intersections, either original focus, full perpendicular lines and arithmetic vertex mean. Primary Table 5 literally says even; least period is the explicit adopted qualification. Padded odd cycles give a false extension. Focus negation supplies no universal opposite-direction claim. Reznik–Garcia–Koiller receive observation credit; the actual v11 PDF title is *Eighty New Invariants in the Elliptic Billiard*.

All 25 originals/reviews/manifests are preserved verbatim as history. Mathematical Sections 2–5 and four original checker programs/receipts remain unchanged. The later 13 evidence files are report/acceptance exports; EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS maps omitted owned dependencies and intended separate complete MAIN audit paths, whose current publication is not asserted. Private primary bodies and runtimes are excluded; this author packet is not a new complete audit replay bundle.

OpenAI Codex (AI) was used extensively for research, drafting, computation and adversarial checking of this reproof packet. It is an unrefereed AI-assisted mathematical draft. Independent AI audits are not human peer review; human peer review has not been performed.

This packet embeds no self-certified repaired-byte verdict or execution authority. Exact package review and native publication acceptance have separate dated repository audit records. No native merge/closure, new target-resolution paper, DOI, tracker credit or release is requested; This author selection repairs only the case’s own QUEUE status/note, preserving 1/5 and every foreign byte. MAIN/global disposition is a separate scope; the author QUEUE payload cannot be used for MAIN.
